name: ultra-3d
description: Ultra 3D pipeline: asks 'Ultra 3D or default?' for any 3D design/modeling request, then runs brief → routing (parametric CAD / Meshy AI mesh / Blender scene) → concept checkpoint → build → mesh checks → rendered review by a 3d-reviewer agent → per-track exports (4K renders + turntable, web GLB within budget + R3F component, STL/3MF + Bambu P2S slice estimate, rigged GLB/FBX). Free local tools plus your Meshy credits, with cost approval before every paid call.

meshy_api_key.title: Meshy API key
meshy_api_key.description: Meshy API key (msy_…, Pro plan or higher). Stored in the system keychain, never in settings files. Leave empty to run the pipeline without Meshy.
